title: Book 9 — Calliope, Chapter 29
paragraphs: All these, except those appointed to attend the Spartans at seven per man, were hoplites, totaling 38,700. This was the total number of hoplites assembled against the barbarian. The number of light-armed men was as follows: of the Spartan division, 35,000, at seven per man, all of them equipped for fighting; and the light-armed troops of the rest of the Lacedaemonians and the other Greeks, about one for each man, amounted to 34,500.
